exceptions.scope: Build and lint tooling with repository-controlled glob patterns; not the SDK, CLI, App Executor or Studio Server execution dependency paths. Runtime image copies omit these unused packages; builders and managed library releases remain separate.
exceptions.reason: GHSA-fc5q-39xc-vjpf has no published patched release as of 2026-11-18; npm latest is 4.0.7 and the advisory covers <=4.0.7. The locked 2.3.2 and 4.0.5 copies are reached by micromatch in lint/build tooling and the optional desktop bundle visualizer. The production web server serves compiled assets using Node built-ins rather than Vite or ESLint. The execution dependency closure is checked by dependency-security-regressions.test.mjs, excluding workspace devDependencies but following production dependencies, optional dependencies and peers. This is a temporary reachability review, not a patched package. Replace it when upstream publishes a verified fix; do not extend it automatically.
